Individual.description: A person in grant work: charity staff, a funder's officer or a trustee. A first name alone is not an identity.

Funder.description: A trust, fund or foundation that gives grants.

Stewardship.description: Who acts for a funder: its program officer handles applicants, its trustees sit on its board.

Signoff.description: Who checks a colleague's bids before they go out: the budget reviewer checks the figures, the proofreader the words.

Application.description: A bid to a funder for one programme. lead_writer writes it, signatory signs it, budget_holder will manage the money; decision is drafting, submitted, awarded or declined.

Report.description: A progress report owed to a funder for one period. accepted stays empty until the funder's acceptance is recorded.

messages.text: Folasade Adeyemi: I'm drafting the literacy programme bid to the Halvorsen Trust, asking for 40,000 pounds, and Matteo Grifoni will sign it.

facts.in: I'm drafting the literacy programme bid to the Halvorsen Trust

messages.text: Anjali Venkataraman is the Halvorsen Trust's program officer for our region, and she replied within a day.

facts.in: Anjali Venkataraman is the Halvorsen Trust's program officer
facts.label: program_officer

messages.text: Matteo Grifoni: I won't be the budget reviewer on Folasade's bid this time. Bettina Kowalczyk checks her budgets now.

facts.in: I won't be the budget reviewer on Folasade's bid this time.
facts.label: budget_reviewer

facts.in: Bettina Kowalczyk checks her budgets now.
facts.label: budget_reviewer

messages.text: Board notes: Anjali Venkataraman and Anjali Mehra both joined the call. Anjali asked whether the youth sport bid could go in again.
Rasmus Eklund filed the spring report to the Tidewell Fund, covering 312 beneficiaries.

facts.in: Rasmus Eklund filed the spring report to the Tidewell Fund

messages.text: The Tidewell Fund wrote back on Monday. Tidewell says the spring report was accepted without changes.

facts.in: Tidewell says the spring report was accepted without changes.

messages.text: Wairimu Njoroge forwarded a line from Siosaia Taufa: "I am happy to act as proofreader for Wairimu again." She thanked him warmly.
quotes: I am happy to act as proofreader for Wairimu again.

facts.in: I am happy to act as proofreader for Wairimu again.
facts.label: proofreader

messages.text: I pinned "no bid leaves without a second reader" above the printer, and Bettina Kowalczyk laughed.
quotes: no bid leaves without a second reader

messages.text: Great news: the Brightwater Foundation awarded our food growing project 18,500 pounds, match funded by the council, with Wairimu Njoroge as budget holder.

facts.in: the Brightwater Foundation awarded our food growing project 18,500 pounds

messages.text: Halvorsen Trust declined the arts outreach application, with the feedback that outcomes were too vague.

facts.in: Halvorsen Trust declined the arts outreach application

messages.text: Bettina Kowalczyk: Rasmus, could you submit the arts outreach bid to the Tidewell Fund before Friday with yourself as lead writer?

facts.in: Rasmus, could you submit the arts outreach bid to the Tidewell Fund

messages.text: Siosaia Taufa said that Matteo Grifoni sits on the Brightwater Foundation board as a trustee.

facts.in: Siosaia Taufa said that Matteo Grifoni sits on the Brightwater Foundation board as a trustee.
facts.label: trustee

messages.text: Anjali Mehra: If the board agrees, I will become Tidewell's grants officer in the autumn.

facts.in: I will become Tidewell's grants officer in the autumn
facts.label: program_officer

messages.text: Anjali Mehra rang about the call notes. The other Anjali, the one at Halvorsen, still owes us feedback.
Rasmus Eklund: I think we could ask Brightwater for maybe 9000 pounds for the repair café, with Wairimu signing.

facts.in: I think we could ask Brightwater for maybe 9000 pounds for the repair café

messages.text: Dear Folasade, Bettina Kowalczyk has agreed to be the proofreader on every bid you send, starting with the literacy programme. I will copy her on the drafts. Best wishes, Siosaia

facts.in: Bettina Kowalczyk has agreed to be the proofreader on every bid you send
facts.label: proofreader

messages.text: Minutes: the autumn report for Brightwater Foundation, filed by Folasade Adeyemi, counted 145 beneficiaries but has not been accepted.

facts.in: the autumn report for Brightwater Foundation

messages.text: Matteo Grifoni chaired the board call, and Grifoni confirmed that the Halvorsen Trust lists him as a trustee.

facts.in: the Halvorsen Trust lists him as a trustee
facts.label: trustee

messages.text: Wairimu Njoroge: Siosaia is not Brightwater's program officer, whatever the website says.

facts.in: Siosaia is not Brightwater's program officer
facts.label: program_officer

messages.text: The literacy programme bid went to the Halvorsen Trust on Tuesday, written by Folasade Adeyemi, signed by Matteo Grifoni, with Bettina Kowalczyk holding the budget.

facts.in: The literacy programme bid went to the Halvorsen Trust on Tuesday

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Application) WHERE n0.programme = 'repair café' RETURN coalesce(n0.match_funded, false) AS match_funded
